text: The Wolf Prize in Mathematics is awarded nearly every year by the Wolf Foundation in Israel and is one of six Wolf Prizes established by the Foundation, which have been awarded since 1978; the other prizes are in Agriculture, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, and Arts. The prize includes a monetary award of $100,000. A reputation survey conducted in 2013 and 2014 ranked the Wolf Prize in Mathematics as the third most prestigious international academic award in mathematics, following the Abel Prize and the Fields Medal.
